messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: billing.metering.token_drift detected in prod · alert_id=ALRT-1769 · severity=P2 · see runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-token-drift 

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Quick summary — is this a spike or a steady drift?

incidents-bot: Detect summary: emitter-v3 -> +~18% token delta vs baseline over 00:00–00:05 UTC. Kafka consumer group kafka-consumer-3 lagging; windowed aggregation showing duplicate windows.

ming (sre): Jumping in. Any customer-facing overage flags triggered? @aj can you confirm?

aj (billing): We have 4 accounts with overage flags (acct-7412, acct-8891, acct-0034, acct-1122). Automation raised flags but charges not issued yet. UI shows inflated usage on the dashboard for those accounts.

sara (oncall): OK. Immediate mitigation proposal: disable emitter-v3 batching and fall back to emitter-v2 (read-only ingestion) so we stop emitting doubled tokens. Ming — can you perform the flip?

ming (sre): On it. Running toggle now. Command: `./infra/run-toggle --service=emitter --from=emitter-v3 --to=emitter-v2 --reason="token drift mitigation"`

devops-bot: Deploy job started · job_id=deploy-338 · rolling update to 3 pods. Logs: ```INFO  deploy-338 starting; target=emitter-v2; safe=true```

ming (sre): Flip applied. Consumers restarted, backpressure removed. Observing metrics for 5m.

sara (oncall): Support, @sam — please prepare a customer-facing blurb: say we detected inflated usage UI for a small number of customers, we are investigating, and we will not apply charges while we reconcile. Hold send until billing ok. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

sam (support): Copy. Drafting note now, will ping for approval.

aj (billing): Approve the note. Also I want to start a ledger-scrub backfill after ingestion stabilizes to reconcile token tallies. I'll queue a safe-replay backfill.

aj (billing): Backfill queued: `backfill-2026-03-18-01` · est 45m · flags=`--safe-replay --idempotent=true`

ming (sre): Metrics trending back to baseline: delta down to +1.5% over last 6m. No new overage flags observed since flip. Consumer lag cleared.

sara (oncall): Excellent. Marking page resolved for oncall. Handing monitoring to billing for ongoing watch (24h). @aj please own post-incident and postmortem.

aj (billing): Will create follow-up in #postmortems and link the runbook + backfill logs. Initial root-cause hypothesis: emitter-v3 batching/windowing regression causing duplicate window emission under certain timing skews.

incidents-bot: PAGER CLEARED: alert_id=ALRT-1769 · duration=12m · resolution=emitter fallback to v2 + backfill queued. Reminder: file incident follow-up and include customer impact assessment (accounts affected, duration, UI vs charge state).
_meta: generated by dataset-generator: incident coordination thread covering token-count drift, mitigation actions, on-call handoff, customer communication and backfill plan
